sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The paid social ads cost {MONEY} last month and brought almost no sign-ups.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Wait, {MONEY}?

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: The creative was pretty weak, though.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We tried three versions.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We pause paid social and move that budget to search ads for the next quarter.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Okay, fair enough.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: I'd argue the paid social creative just wasn't good.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We tested three versions, it's not the creative.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We spent {MONEY} and got close to zero sign-ups.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: {MONEY}, okay.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Paid social is paused, and the budget goes to search ads next quarter.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Alright.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We need to pick the launch date for the brand refresh.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The agency can only deliver the final files by {DATE_ABS}.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Right, {DATE_ABS}.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Sorry, {S3}, you were saying?

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: And we don't want to launch in the holiday week.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Then we launch the refresh the Monday after the files arrive.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Good, that gives us a buffer.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Final files from the agency won't be ready before {DATE_ABS}.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Right, {S2}.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: {DATE_ABS} comes around fast.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Let's also avoid the holiday week.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: So the refresh goes live on the first Monday after we receive the files.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Makes sense.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Sorry, {S2}, you were saying?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Do we keep doing the monthly webinar?

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Attendance dropped to {NUMBER} people last time.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: But the recordings get decent views afterwards.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We'll move to a quarterly webinar and put more effort into each one.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: I like that.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: The last webinar only had {NUMBER} people live.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: {S2}, you had something on this?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The recordings do get watched later, though.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Let's switch to one webinar per quarter and make each one stronger.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Sounds good.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Agreed.
